title: E. coli MG1655 + B. subtilis 168 sigE- shared-resource competition
warning: Experimental model-unit scenario. Shared-resource and local-capacity competition are authoritative, but model-resource is not glucose and model-biomass is not dry weight or cell count.

resourceContext.initialCondition: Caller-supplied uniform model-resource level; no physical glucose concentration is implied.
resourceContext.biomassMapping: Model-biomass has no physical gCDW, CFU, cell-count, or biovolume mapping in this scenario.

provenance.context: Two-bacterium shared-resource execution before a compatible physical glucose/biomass unit bridge is calibrated.
provenance.limitation: The source studies provide isolated glucose-minimal physiology targets, not a physical mapping for Petra's model-resource/model-biomass fields.

engineeringDefaults.note: Numerical dish resolution and grid pitch are engineering geometry, not physical plate dimensions.

provenance.context: Experimental two-bacterium execution in model units using the same stable normalized ecology family as the current flagship.
provenance.calibrationNote: Run-wide ecology coefficients remain engineering-normalized. Species-specific isolated growth evidence enters only through the explicit founder baseline growth-rate scale ratio.
provenance.limitation: This profile is not a measured Monod, physical glucose-yield, colony-speed, carrying-capacity, or biomass-unit calibration.

provenance.context: First executable two-bacterium shared-resource parameter set.
provenance.calibrationNote: E. coli is the relative growth reference at scale 1. Bacillus baseline growth-rate scale is derived as 0.67/0.69 from the isolated source mean growth rates; all other ecology coefficients remain the scenario engineering profile.
provenance.limitation: The ratio transfers separate-study isolated growth means into Petra model-unit relative growth. It is not a measured coculture competition coefficient or absolute growth-rate fit.

growthTarget.context: Wild-type K-12 MG1655 on glucose minimal medium; separate-study isolated-growth calibration target.
